rejections.HC-007: Hindustan Zinc v. State of Raj. (2012) is a RAJASTHAN LAND TAX case (Rajasthan Finance Act 2006, ss.38-48, Rule 24) — NOT s.126/s.135 Electricity Act. Harvested as a false positive: petitioners include power/oil-generation companies and it cites Southco v. Seetaram Rice Mills (2012) 2 SCC 108 only for the onerous-pre-deposit / alternative-remedy point. No Electricity Act provision is construed. Needs a topical replacement (candidate: Southco v. Seetaram Rice Mills itself — a leading SC s.126 authority — or another HC s.126/135 case).
rejections.HC-012: West Bengal State Electricity Board v. Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax (Cal, 2005) is an INCOME-TAX case (Income Tax Act 1961 s.201(1A) interest on TDS default; s.120 jurisdiction; audi alteram partem) — NOT s.126/s.135 Electricity Act. Harvested as a false positive purely because WBSEB (an electricity utility) is the assessee. No Electricity Act provision is construed. Needs a topical replacement (a genuine Calcutta HC s.126/135 case, e.g. on theft assessment or the WBSEDCL supply code).
rejections.HC-015: Odisha Power Generation Corporation Ltd. v. State of Odisha (AIR 2015 Orissa 128) is an ENTRY-TAX case (Orissa Entry Tax Act 1999 s.9C assessment; concessional entry-tax rate on coal used as raw material for generating electricity; Rule 3 OET Rules; limitation) — NOT s.126/s.135 Electricity Act. Harvested as a false positive purely because OPGC is a power-generation company. No Electricity Act provision is construed. Needs a topical replacement (a genuine Orissa HC s.126/135 case — note Seetaram Rice Mill itself arose from Orissa/SOUTHCO).
